Self-contained transmitters in one IC package are the shape of things to come. This dramatically reduces the effort required for troubleshooting. Indeed, in most instances, replacing U1 will fix whatever problem the transmitter is having.
During the analysis in the previous lesson, it was seen that U1 on PC130-456 contained nearly the entire transmitter.
The NIDA PC130-456 and PC130-457 circuit cards comprise the entire NBFM system, both transmitter and receiver.

Beyond over-modulation, which can drive the signal into an adjacent channel, there aren't any system-specific problems inherently NBFM related. In reality, even the over-modulation problem is not NBFM related, but rather, narrowband related, which is used in AM Communication Systems, as well.
OVERMODULATED
